mustFix.problem: Every image is a placeholder gradient with a visible 'Placeholder for ...' caption; the niche library holds only placeholder-*.webp
mustFix.fix: Curate real approved autotuneup media (niche media stage) and rebuild; never render 'Placeholder for ...' text on the page

mustFix.problem: 'Pull in, grab a seat and the Wi-Fi.' claims an amenity not in facts.json
mustFix.fix: Replace with 'Pull in, hand over the keys and wait. You're out before your coffee's cold.'

elevate.move: Art-direct real frames as the stations themselves: one tight process crop per lap (keys at check-in, oil drain, old filter next to new, tread gauge, hand-back ticket) revealed by the same rail-fill clip as its lap, all in one warm bay-light grade, so the photos are the splits rather than decoration.

Make the hero strip the starting line: a letterboxed bay frame with the stopwatch case sitting on its top edge, an h1 that names Provo oil changes and tune-ups, and the first lap ('Check-in · 2 min') already ticking on the strip, so trade, place and signature land in three seconds.
